entries.reasoning: TravelHub is a "Hospitality Business" under §1.11 of the Al Noor MSA as it provides distribution services to "Partner Hotels". The scope of the new contract involves "artificial intelligence" (personalization and ranking engines) and "data analytics" (performance dashboard) which are restricted under §12.1. The services relate to properties and operations in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, and Jeddah, placing them "in the GCC" per §12.2, and AtliQ Inc is a bound Affiliate.

incomingClauses.quote: Itinerary Personalization Engine — a recommendation service that generates personalised day-by-day itineraries using user preferences, trip purpose, budget, travel dates, past bookings and in-app behaviour, and re-ranks suggested activities, restaurants and experiences in real time;

Partner Hotel Ranking Module — a ranking and recommendation service that scores, ranks and surfaces Partner Hotels in the United Arab Emirates and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to TravelHub users at the point of search and itinerary building
Partner Performance Dashboard — a dashboard for TravelHub's partnerships team showing impressions, click-through, bookings and commission by Partner Hotel, city and ranking position;

entries.suggestedChange: Delay the commencement of GCC-based AI and analytics services for hotel distribution until the expiry of the Al Noor restricted period in September 2029, or seek a specific waiver from Al Noor.
entries.waiverWhy: The Al Noor waiver letter dated 10 February 2026 is strictly limited to services for Seaside Hotels LLC in Oman and explicitly excludes any other Hospitality Business in the GCC.
entries.impact: Collides with the Al Noor exclusivity commitment, which is active until September 2029 and covers all AtliQ Affiliates for GCC-based hospitality AI and analytics.
